findings.claim: 10-K FY2025 Item 3 未列出反壟斷或政府調查為重大訴訟，主要訴訟為各司法管轄區的住宿稅／占用稅訴訟。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 3 Legal Proceedings
findings.excerpt: A number of jurisdictions in the United States have filed lawsuits against online travel companies, including Expedia Group companies such as Hotels.com, Expedia, Hotwire, Orbitz and HomeAway, claiming that such travel companies have failed to collect and/or pay taxes

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因素：公司過去曾涉及多國競爭主管機關對價格平價條款的調查，並以自願承諾處理；無法預測未來監管行動。
findings.excerpt: Expedia Group companies have also historically been involved in a number of investigations by national competition authorities related to whether certain parity clauses in contracts between Expedia Group entities and accommodation providers are anti-competitive

findings.claim: 2026-10 提起全國性反壟斷集體訴訟 Andrews v. Expedia Group（W.D. Wash.），指控平價條款與搜尋排名懲罰使飯店價格偏高；Expedia 稱指控無理由。
findings.excerpt: “meritless,” saying the company has brought transparency, competitive offerings and better value to the world of travel shopping for more than 30 years. Expedia charges hotels a commission, which is calculated into the price customers pay to book a room on its site.
